name: Fortune’s Frown
body:
School transmutation; Level bard 1, cleric/oracle 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V,S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level; see text (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The target creature becomes unlucky. Any luck bonuses the target possesses are immediately dispelled for the duration of the spell. In addition, when the target rolls a d20, it must roll two d20s and take the worse result.

This effect lasts for the duration of the spell or after 1d4 rounds, whichever comes first.

Mythic: The target also takes a penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, skill checks, and ability checks equal to half your mythic tier (minimum 1). This effect and all others last for 1 min./level.
